svg.title: Do-not-coat areas on an assembly drawing
svg.desc: Drawn to scale, plan view of a 60 by 40 mm board as it would appear on an assembly drawing. Areas that must stay free of conformal coating are outlined in red and labeled: a connector's mating area at the right edge, a push switch, and a row of test points. The nearest part that must be coated sits 2 to 3 mm from the edge of the connector's keep-out.

g.text: Drawn to scale. Dimensions in mm.
2–3 mm is about the closest a selective coating process holds to a keep-out edge (PCB-DFA-061).
